characters.name: MARI
characters.description: Väike inimene, tüdruk heledate juuste ja kahe patsiga, seljas kollane kampsun ja sinised püksid, jalas punased kummikud. Sõbralik ja rõõmus näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: PEETER
characters.description: Väike inimene, poiss pruunide lühikeste juustega, seljas roheline kampsun ja pruunid püksid, jalas kollased kummikud. Lõbus ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Aed sügisel
locations.description: A colorful autumn garden with green grass scattered with red, yellow, and orange fallen leaves. A large apple tree with reddish-yellow leaves stands on the left. In the background, a low wooden fence and a blue sky with soft white clouds. Bright and cozy autumn atmosphere. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Mari (blonde girl in yellow sweater, blue pants, red boots) and Peeter (brown-haired boy in green sweater, brown pants, yellow boots) stand side by side in a sunny autumn garden. The green grass is lightly scattered with colorful autumn leaves. A large apple tree with autumn leaves and a wooden fence are in the background.

Mari and Peeter stand in the autumn garden, looking happily down at the ground covered in brightly colored red, yellow, and orange autumn leaves around their boots. Same garden setup with green grass, apple tree, and wooden fence.
Mari smiles happily as she picks up a large wooden garden rake that was leaning against the wooden fence. Peeter watches her cheerfully. The ground is scattered with autumn leaves.
Peeter holds up a slightly smaller wooden garden rake with a big smile. Mari stands next to him holding her own rake. They are both ready to work in the autumn garden.
Mari and Peeter actively use their wooden rakes to sweep colorful leaves across the grass into a central pile. A growing mound of red and yellow leaves is gathering between them.
Mari and Peeter stand proudly beside a huge, tall pile of gathered red, orange, and yellow autumn leaves. They lean happily on their wooden rakes, looking at the massive leaf pile.
Peeter leaps joyfully into the middle of the giant pile of leaves, caught mid-air over the soft colorful pile. Leaves fly gently around him. Mari stands nearby holding her rake, laughing happily.
Mari leaps mid-air into the giant leaf pile right beside Peeter, who is sitting happily in the leaves. Colorful leaves spray into the air around them both in a playful moment.
Mari and Peeter sit side by side inside the huge leaf pile, covered in colorful autumn leaves, laughing together with arms raised in joy. Their rakes lie safely on the grass beside the pile.
